result.title: GLCR: Global-Local Collaborative Routing for Multi-Task Electromagnetic Signal Processing
result.comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Dawn-try/GLCR
result.summary: Deep neural networks for electromagnetic signal processing are typically developed as single-task experts with fixed inputs and objectives, limiting cross-task transferability. Electromagnetic foundation models offer broader task coverage but incur substantial pretraining and inference costs. To balance accuracy and efficiency, we adopt model routing to dynamically dispatch unknown signals to matched experts within a heterogeneous pool. We construct HeteroSignal-7, a multi-task routing benchmark with 140,000 samples from seven datasets covering six task types, paired with seven classification and waveform-recovery experts and a unified evaluation protocol. We then propose GLCR, a two-stage routing method combining global dispatch with local discrimination of similar tasks. First, a lightweight one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) with an additive-margin head predicts one of seven routing classes. Second, a gradient-boosted-tree specialist uses four physical statistics to re-evaluate samples whose top two candidates match a confusion pair automatically identified from validation errors. The pipeline is trained across the full signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range and requires neither SNR labels nor noise estimation at inference time. GLCR outperforms all 19 baselines, achieving 96.16% routing accuracy and a 76.30% system score, exceeding the respective second-best baselines by 1.16% and 1.14%. It achieves the lowest routing latency among the compared methods at 1.43 ms per sample and reduces expected overall system FLOPs by 5.9 times compared with executing all experts. This work provides a public evaluation platform and an efficient, reproducible baseline for heterogeneous expert routing in electromagnetic signal processing.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建电磁信号多任务路由基准 HeteroSignal-7，并提出 GLCR 两阶段路由方法：先用轻量一维 CNN 在七个专家间做全局分派，再对落入验证误差所识别混淆对的样本，用四个物理统计量驱动的梯度提升树做局部再判别。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「粗分派—按混淆对触发二次精判」的结构和以平均 FLOPs 衡量收益的方式，可作为 LVR 中按需追加计算与停止决策、路由成本的类比线索，具体可迁移性待核查。
